messages:
Sam: Heads-up: we found a scheduling issue in the runtime that can cause sporadic tail-latency spikes when batch sizes briefly double. Low incident rate but noticeable for long-sequence workloads. We're requesting a release-freeze exemption to ship a small scheduler patch tonight. :warning:
Priya: Can you quantify "sporadic"? how many customers affected?
Sam: ~0.7% of requests during peak batch churn; mostly Dedicated customers on heavy-embedding runs. Token 99p increases by ~150-200ms in repro tests.
Alex: Product + support side: CS wants advance notice for Dedicated accounts. We'll keep Hosted traffic on default variant until canary proves stable.
Nia: SRE: low blast radius patch looks safe, but we want a controlled canary ramp: 0% -> 5% -> 25% -> full over 4h with checks. Need freeze exemption approval.
Sam: Requesting exemption: risk=low, customer-impact=medium (tail latency), security=none. Please react :thumbsup: or :thumbsdown:.
CTO-bot: Exec notification sent to CTO and VP Eng.
Emma: :thumbsup: from infra. I'll own the canary verification dashboard.
Priya: :thumbsup: from SRE on monitoring.
Alex: :thumbsup: product ok.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: repo=runtime-scheduler, branch=fix/scheduler-batch-edge, target=canary, initiated_by=@Sam
Nia: Planned steps: 1) baseline canary at 0% for 20m, 2) deploy patch to canary instances, 3) run replay of problematic traces + synthetic load for 15m, 4) if green bump to 5% for 30m, then 25% for 60m, then full. Rollback criteria: 95p latency regression >5% or error_rate >0.5%.
Sam: Command I'll run after approvals:
```
./scripts/deploy.sh --env=canary --image=runtime-scheduler:fix-2026-03-23 --strategy=manual
```
Priya: SRE-bot please enable additional trace sampling and a short-term latency alert during the rollout.
SRE-bot: Trace sampling increased to 5%. Temporary alert rule "scheduler_tail_latency" enabled.
Alex: Lena from CS is on standby for customer outreach. @Lena could you prepare the Dedicated notice?
Lena: On it, will post templated message in #customer-comms once we hit 5% green.
Sam: Approvals look good. Initiating canary baseline now.
deploy-bot: canary baseline started. collecting metrics window=20m
Sam: Baseline complete. No new anomalies. Proceeding to deploy patch to canary.
deploy-bot: deploy started: runtime-scheduler/canary -> image runtime-scheduler:fix-2026-03-23. build=6512
Nia: Smoke checks: no crashes, CPU steady, KV cache behavior unchanged. Starting synthetic replay now.
Sam: Replay complete; observed 95p latency drop ~120ms on reproduced traces. Good sign.
SRE-bot: Canary health: PASS. anomaly_score=0.02, error_rate=0.0005.
Sam: Bumping to 5% now.
deploy-bot: rollout update: canary -> 5% complete.
Priya: Monitoring 15m window. so far 99p latency trending down for replayed traces. No errors.
Lena: Posting initial customer note to top Dedicated accounts: "Wedeployed a small runtime improvement to reduce tail latency for embedding-heavy workloads. We will monitor and follow up."
Alex: Keep ramp plan. If 5% holds for 30m we'll move to 25%. If anything odd, rollback to previous image.
Sam: 5% window complete and stable, starting bump to 25%.
deploy-bot: rollout update: 5% -> 25% in progress.
Nia: System load normal, no spike in error logs. 
Emma: Observability: traces show scheduler queue times shorter after patch. Nice.
Priya: 25% window 40m in, metrics still good. I'll run an extended synthetic that mimics bursty batching.
Sam: Thanks. Also creating a short changelog blurb for release train notes and will tag this thread.
Priya: Extended synthetic done: passes. 95p latency improved vs baseline by ~100-140ms on problematic traces.
Alex: Product: prepare support FAQ in case customers see a brief config mismatch.
Lena: CS FAQ drafted, linking in #customer-comms.
Sam: Final ramp to 100% scheduled over next 90m. We'll keep alerts active for 6h post-roll.
SRE-bot: Post-roll alerts retention=6h. Temporary rules active.
CTO-bot: Noted by execs. Great coordination.
Sam: Summary: freeze-exemption granted, scheduler patch applied to canary, passed all checks, ramping to full now. If nothing regresses we'll close this out and include the fix in the weekly release notes. :white_check_mark:
Alex: Thanks team. Ill file a brief retro note if anything unexpected pops up.
Nia: I'll archive the monitoring snapshots and attach to the release ticket.
Sam: Link to diff for records: https://git.internal/runtime-scheduler/compare/fix-scheduler-batch-edge
Alex: Closing thread  will update release train changelog entry with the final note later today. :spiral_calendar:
